links.outcome: Sensitivity and recall rate of single human reader combined with AI as independent second reader in breast screening
links.effect: Combined single human reading with AI recalled 2112 mammograms (5.0%) vs 1244 (2.9%) for double human reading; sensitivity improved by 8.4% (95% CI 5.7-11.2, p<0.0001); 282 screen-detected cancers plus 29 interval and 38 future cancers detected
links.tradeoff: Recall rate increased (5.0% vs 2.9%), so an effective arbitration process is needed
links.quote: Evaluating screening mammograms with one human reader and AI leads to increased breast cancer detection compared with double human reading, independent of breast density.

design_hint: AI as independent second reader replacing one human reader
